exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: canonical principal fictional-adult character continuity sheet for an original webtoon, owner-review-pending
Input images: Image 1 is the registered style-system anchor created in this experiment; preserve its original Sola identity, palette, contour, and rendering.
Primary request: Create one clean portrait reference sheet divided into exactly three stacked full-body-to-knee frames of the same Sola Merrow, fictional adult woman age 38, visibly mature athletic working build, warm brown skin, long dark auburn hair in one low segmented braid, one silver forelock, ochre scarf, slate trousers and practical boots.
Frame 1: baseline front three-quarter stance in long deep-navy pathwright coat with ivory piping and intact copper oath bracer.
Frame 2: post-injury stance with left forearm ivory brace, left sleeve cut, short navy field coat, no rank pins; same face and body.
Frame 3: late-volume stance with broken bracer absent, clean white Sever line across palm and a sparse translucent cyan-gold Chorus mantle over the short coat; same identity.
Style: original clean cinematic fantasy-webtoon, crisp dark-navy contours, limited interior lines, smooth restrained cel shading, pearl/midnight support and selective cyan-gold accent.
Composition: neutral pale blue-gray background, ample separation, large readable hands, no turntable labels.
Constraints: same adult identity in all three frames; practical non-sexualized clothing; no text, letters, numbers, boxes, balloons, logos, signatures, watermarks; no children or young-looking adults; no real-person likeness; no third-party design; no named-style imitation.
Avoid: woodcut, hatching, paper grain, grunge, clutter, multiple effects, glossy 3D.
